# Complex

![Complex function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/numeric/32-complexe.svg)

[Numeric functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Opens functions for constructing and transforming complex values.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**Complexe**

Ouvre les fonctions de construction et de transformation des valeurs complexes.

</details>

## Browse this palette

This entry opens a palette folder; it is not an executable dataflow function.

| Entry | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Complex Conjugate](complex/conjugate.md) | Returns the complex conjugate of the input value. |
| [Polar To Complex](complex/polar_to_complex.md) | Builds a complex value from its magnitude and phase. |
| [Complex To Polar](complex/complex_to_polar.md) | Extracts the magnitude and phase of a complex value. |
| [Re/Im To Complex](complex/real_imaginary_to_complex.md) | Builds a complex value from its real and imaginary components. |
| [Complex To Re/Im](complex/complex_to_real_imaginary.md) | Extracts the real and imaginary components of a complex value. |
| [Re/Im To Polar](complex/real_imaginary_to_polar.md) | Converts real and imaginary components to magnitude and phase. |
| [Polar To Re/Im](complex/polar_to_real_imaginary.md) | Converts magnitude and phase to real and imaginary components. |
